# Parthenon Diner

> Family diner and Greek restaurant in Branford and Old Saybrook, CT. Breakfast served all day, classic American comfort food & Greek specialties since 1985.

Parthenon Diner is a family-owned restaurant that has been serving Connecticut's shoreline communities since 1985. We have two locations: our original in Branford at 374 East Main Street (near Branford Green on Route 1) and our second location at 809 Boston Post Road in Old Saybrook. We serve classic American diner food alongside authentic Greek specialties, with breakfast available all day at both locations.

## Locations & Hours

### Branford

## Menu

Our menu features breakfast (omelettes, pancakes, waffles, eggs benedict), lunch (sandwiches, burgers, salads, soups), dinner (steaks, seafood, pasta, chicken entrees), and Greek specialties (gyros, souvlaki, moussaka, spanakopita). Popular items include the Hungry Man breakfast ($14), Belgian Waffle ($9), Classic Eggs Benedict ($14), Parthenon Burger ($14), Deli Reuben ($17), Greek Salad ($13), Grilled Flank Steak ($19), Broiled Salmon ($24), Chicken Souvlaki ($15.50), Beef & Lamb Gyro ($16), Spanakopita ($15), and Moussaka ($18).

## Services

- Breakfast served all day
- Online ordering for pickup via Toast
- Gift cards available in any amount, valid at both locations, never expire
- Rewards program with points earned on every visit
- Private event and party hosting at both locations

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What are Parthenon Diner's hours?**
Parthenon Diner Branford is open Sunday through Thursday from 7 AM to 10 PM, and Friday and Saturday from 7 AM to 11 PM. The Old Saybrook location is open Monday through Saturday from 7 AM to 9 PM, and Sunday from 7 AM to 8 PM.

**Where is Parthenon Diner located?**
Parthenon Diner has two locations in Connecticut. The Branford location is at 374 East Main Street, Branford, CT 06405. The Old Saybrook location is at 809 Boston Post Road, Old Saybrook, CT.

**What kind of food does Parthenon Diner serve?**
Parthenon Diner serves classic American diner food with Greek specialties. The menu includes breakfast items like omelettes and eggs benedict served all day, as well as burgers, sandwiches, salads, and authentic Greek dishes like gyros, souvlaki, moussaka, and spanakopita.

**Does Parthenon Diner serve breakfast all day?**
Yes, Parthenon Diner serves breakfast all day at both locations. You can enjoy omelettes, pancakes, waffles, eggs benedict, and other breakfast favorites any time during operating hours.

**Does Parthenon Diner offer online ordering?**
Yes, Parthenon Diner offers online ordering for pickup at both locations via Toast.

**Does Parthenon Diner have gift cards?**
Yes, gift cards are available in any amount, valid at both locations, and never expire. They can be purchased online.

**Does Parthenon Diner host private events?**
Yes, Parthenon Diner has space available for private events, parties, celebrations, and gatherings at both the Branford and Old Saybrook locations.
